description: THE tool for last/first/most-recent questions — search completed bouts across UFCalendar's launch promotions by title fight, finish method (ko, sub, dec, finish), division, fighter, winner, main-event only and date range, newest first by default. One call answers "the last title fight to end by knockout"; never page the schedule for it. At least one narrowing filter is required; 25 rows per page, 10 pages deep.

division.description: Division slug ("lightweight", "womens-strawweight") for an exact match, or a name fragment.

fighter.description: Fighter slug or id — bouts this fighter was in.

method.description: ko = KO/TKO, sub = submission, dec = any decision, finish = KO/TKO or submission, any = no filter.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

winner.description: Fighter slug or id — bouts this fighter won.

name: find_fights
title: Find fights
